# 247clerk

> 247clerk is a WhatsApp AI clerk that handles after-hours client intake for South African professional practices — attorneys, immigration practitioners, tax practitioners, conveyancers, financial advisers and estate agents. It screens the matter, answers process and fee questions, books the consultation, collects the consultation fee, and escalates anything requiring professional advice to the practitioner.

247clerk runs on a practice's existing WhatsApp business number. It is explicitly built not to give legal, tax or financial advice: it answers process, fee, document and availability questions, screens enquiries against criteria the practice defines, and hands anything touching the merits of a matter to an admitted practitioner. It will sign an operator agreement under POPIA (Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013) on request.

Key facts:
- Market: South Africa. Pricing in rand.
- Channel: WhatsApp (not voice).
- Plans: Front Desk R349/month; Full Shift R649/month. 14-day free trial on both.
- Setup time: about 15 minutes. Nothing for clients to install.
- Integrations: Google Calendar, PayFast, Stripe.
- Contact: admin@247clerk.com
